segment.description: Crab Orchard Creek, a substantial Emory River tributary in Cumberland and Morgan County country (Emory/Obed basin, HUC 06010208). Catalog gives no named reach bounds; the temperature evidence below is from USGS station 03540100 on the upper creek (Morgan County).
segment.boundaries: No formal reach bounds in the catalog; USGS discrete temperature samples cited here come from station 03540100 'CRAB ORCHARD CREEK NEAR DEERMONT, TN' (36.01109, -84.61199), on the upper creek in Morgan County.

coldSource.notes: USGS 03540100 'CRAB ORCHARD CREEK NEAR DEERMONT, TN': Morgan County (FIPS 129), HUC 06010208, altitude 911.16 ft, drainage 33.7 sq mi — a free-flowing upper-creek station with only a 1966-1981 historical record (discharge and discrete water-quality samples), verified via waterservices series catalog: https://waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/site/?sites=03540090,03540100,03540102,03540105&seriesCatalogOutput=true&siteStatus=all&format=rdb

holdover.detail: No holdover can be documented: the creek has no TWRA trout stocking row (checked 'Crab Orchard' against the 2026 row-level stocking schedule) and no trout regulation of any kind.

wildPopulation.detail: Absent from TWRA's Wild Trout Streams list (that list covers Monroe/Carter/Johnson/Greene/Unicoi county waters only); no trout survey record for Crab Orchard Creek was found.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: USGS discrete samples on the upper creek reached 28.9 C (Jul 1966) and 27.0 C (Jul 1980), and the creek carries no TWRA trout stocking row, wild-trout listing, or special regulation.

sourcesChecked: https://waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/site/?format=rdb&countyCd=47035&siteOutput=expanded&siteStatus=all (no Crab Orchard Creek station in Cumberland County - the 'near Crab Orchard' stations 03539498/03539500 are on Byrd Creek and Daddys Creek, different waters)
